desc:
🍔 Win rock-paper-scissors and EAT — lose and RUN! 🏃

Face another player at the food table: the winner of each round stuffs their face, the loser sprints down the track to the finish line and back. 3 rounds — whoever eats the most wins!

✊✋✌️ Play rock-paper-scissors against real players (or a bot when the server is quiet)
😋 Won the round? Tap to EAT as fast as you can!
🏃 Lost it? RUN to the line and back before your rival eats everything
⚡ Train your Speed on treadmills — the faster you run, the less they eat
🍕 Train your Eat Power at the food tables — bigger bites, bigger wins
🔥 Unlock crazy foods, treadmills, battle tables and lanes
🏆 Earn trophies, build win streaks and climb the leaderboards
📋 New daily quests every day

Can you out-eat AND out-run the whole server? 🔥
